page_title: EVE 1-1 CRY | Everton v Crystal Palace 19/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' 19:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90+1' Beto (Everton) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Wharton trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Ozoh (Crystal Palace).
87' A yellow card for bad language! Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
87' James Tarkowski (Everton) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header high over the bar from close range.
84' 1 - 1 Amadou Onana (Everton) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 1:1.
84' The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
83' James Garner (Everton) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Sam Johnstone stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
79' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) latches onto a lofted pass from Dwight McNeil on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
79' Amadou Onana (Everton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
77' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
77' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
75' The attendance is 38164.
74' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
72' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Abdoulaye Doucoure and he is replaced by Beto (Everton).
72' Substitution. Odsonne Edouard leaves the pitch and is replaced by Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace).
71' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.
68' Total attempts – 13:9.
66' 0 - 1 Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) struck from medium range. He smashed the ball inside the left post. What a hit! Pure magic.
66' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Jack Harrison (Everton) replaces Ashley Young.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Amadou Onana (Everton) is brought on as a substitute for Idrissa Gueye.
64' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) drives a shot towards the left side of the goal from inside the box, but Sam Johnstone leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
64' James Tarkowski (Everton) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
64' Everton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
60' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
60' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by James Garner (Everton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
60' Paul Tierney blows his whistle. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) commits a foul after dangerous play.
58' The ball falls kindly for Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
57' The linesman makes the right call and Crystal Palace will have a corner.
57' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
56' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the left side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
55' James Garner (Everton) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
52' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) brings his opponent down. Paul Tierney has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Everton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
47' Ashley Young (Everton) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
46' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) trips an opposition player and Paul Tierney signals a foul.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box and produces a poor header which goes well wide of the right post.
43' A lofted cross from Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
40' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
39' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) sends the corner into the box, but Jordan Pickford intercepts it and averts the threat.

38' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) plants a goal-bound header towards the right post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders reacts superbly and makes a timely interception.
38' The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
38' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
37' 5:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
35' Flag goes up against Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
34' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
33' Referee Paul Tierney sees the trip by Ashley Young (Everton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
31' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
31' The free kick is taken by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace), but ball is cleared.
30' Poor challenge! Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is penalised for tripping and Paul Tierney blows his whistle.
29' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is caught offside!
28' Ashley Young (Everton) meets a cross from Vitali Mykolenko, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the right post.
26' James Garner (Everton) strikes the ball from the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort goes high over the bar.
25' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) tackles a bit over-zealously and Paul Tierney blows for a foul. Everton have a free kick from a promising distance.

23' Chance! Dwight McNeil sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
19' Some neat passing and movement from Everton as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
17' Foul! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
15' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
14' The linesman signals that Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
14' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
13' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
12' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Jordan Pickford is alert and denies him.
10' Ben Godfrey (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Paul Tierney blows his whistle after James Garner (Everton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
9' James Garner (Everton) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
6' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
1' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and it's Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
1' The first half has just begun.
Crystal Palace will kick the game off.
Paul Tierney is introduced as the referee for today's match.
